verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a terminal and SSH/Mosh client that bundles local Unix commands and a VS Code-based coding experience, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it ships local git tooling. The documented local command list (cat, grep, ls, cp, curl, scp, sftp, etc.) does not include git, and nothing in the evidence describes interactive rebase or commit editing, squashing or reordering. Running git on a remote host over SSH would be a host-side capability and earns no credit here.
